latestVersion.changelog:
Ezviz Safety Production Inspection Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of workplace safety production inspection for Ezviz cameras.
- Captures device images and sends them to Ezviz AI for analysis of safety helmet use, fall detection, cleanliness, and fire/smoke hazards.
- Supports automatic agent creation based on the "安全生产行业通用智能体" template if needed.
- Requires dedicated Ezviz app credentials and device serial(s) via environment variables or config file.
- Token securely cached with file permissions set to 600.
- Comprehensive user guide and security checklist included.
